title: In repos/development-vessel/src/resolvers/feature-compose.ts, fix creation-goal apply: when a compose op targets a sourc
description: In repos/development-vessel/src/resolvers/feature-compose.ts, fix creation-goal apply: when a compose op targets a source file that does not yet exist, it must CREATE the file rather than fail. Root cause (measured, dispatch 8d98f763 / route-edit-15b1240a): for a goal to create a new file, the drafter emitted an op with kind:"edit" pointing at a not-yet-existing path; per the drafter prompt an edit to a path not already present fails at apply with "ENOENT: no such file or directory, open <path>", so op_count=1 apply_failed, rolled_back, verdict UNFAVORABLE — no file created. feature_compose already supports a create_file op; the defect is that a new-file intent lands as kind:"edit" and ENOENTs by design. Fix it deterministically at the point where the file tree is known: when an op's target path is absent in the compose worktree, promote it to a create_file (mkdir -p the parent, write the intended new content) instead of opening a nonexistent file — guard so it only fires when the path is genuinely absent, leaving normal edits to existing files unchanged. Preserve the existing ENOENT/parent-dir handling.
